title: Estimate Overage Credits on Authorized Concern Lines — Service Accounts and Repair Orders Desk Guide
content:
**Ruling.** On every account this policy sets the estimate overage credit on an authorized line: the customer-pay labor and parts billed on the line may exceed what the customer authorized by the estimate tolerance, and anything billed beyond that tolerance without a further authorization is credited back as an estimate overage credit.

**Where it applies.** Every account of Service Accounts and Repair Orders, retail and fleet alike, when a repair order is paid and a concern line of it was worked on a written estimate the customer authorized.

**What is booked.** The overage credit is booked against the line's latest customer-pay labor charge as an estimate overage credit. It lowers the amount owed on the service account by the credit, and the customer sees it on the repair order.

## Tool: `credit_estimate_overage_3db3cf5c`
**Capability.** Books one estimate overage credit against a named labor charge of a repair order, dated today, and lowers the amount owed on the service account by the credit.

**How it is invoked.** An agent-side tool: the agent unlocks `credit_estimate_overage_3db3cf5c` and then calls it.

**Parameters.**
| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `service_account_id` | Reference number of the customer's service account, as returned by the service account lookup | Id |
| `repair_order_number` | Repair order number of the concern line, copied from the repair order lines returned by the ledger lookup | Verbatim, character for character, no normalisation |
| `line_letter` | The concern line credited | One of `A` (first concern line), `B`, `C`, `D`, `E`, `F`, `G`, `H` (eighth), or `not_applicable` (a charge belonging to the repair order as a whole); it must be the concern line of the charge named by `source_line_id` |
| `source_line_id` | Reference number of the labor charge the credit reduces, as returned for that charge by the ledger lookup | Id of a labor charge of the same service account and repair order |
| `credit_amount` | The overage credit | US dollars, 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent (further digits are rounded half up), greater than zero, plain decimal notation with no currency sign, separators or exponent |

**Return.** A one-line receipt beginning with the word Credited, naming the credit reference, the repair order number and concern line, the credit amount and the resulting amount owed on the account. A string beginning with Error is returned, and nothing is booked, when `credit_amount` is not a plain decimal amount greater than zero after rounding, when `line_letter` is outside the set above, when `source_line_id` does not name a labor charge of this service account and repair order, or when `line_letter` is not the concern line of that charge.
